deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To integrate Claude API with Baukjen's Shopify platform, start by creating an account on the Claude dashboard and obtaining a unique API key. Next, navigate to your Shopify admin panel and click on 'Apps' > 'Manage apps', then select 'Custom app' and enter the Claude API URL. Finally, configure the API settings to connect your Shopify store with Claude's AI writing capabilities.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.

market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Baukjen's established tech budget and need for nuanced, brand-voice-consistent fashion copy make Claude a strong fit.
Baukjen can leverage Jasper's marketing-focused AI writing capabilities and fashion/retail content templates to generate high-quality product descriptions.

While ChatGPT's general-purpose AI writing capabilities are useful, Baukjen's specific need for sustainability-focused product descriptions and lack of Shopify integration make it a less ideal choice.
